notes_for_editor: County conflict, unresolved: the FFLA lists San Jacinto; tnlandforms lists Liberty and tags the entry TFS. The record's county is left at San Jacinto because no source read settles the county line at 30.46865, -94.94559; an editor with a county boundary source could settle it. The TFS tag is not explained on the page read, so no agency is recorded. No build, staffing, fire or current-site source was found for this site. The NGS BL1105 datasheet covers Loc 1 and is cited only for the nearby abandoned tower and its location. The 1985 pastmaps Rayburn-map blurb (https://pastmaps.com/explore/us/texas/san-jacinto-county/shepherd) is not specific to this site and is not used. Confidence low: two list entries, one with a county conflict, and no narrative source.
